samples.comment: The HomGar app exposes no signal field for this model (issue #92): Device Name, ID, Model, Address, Sensor Correction and Battery Level only. The legacy header's third field is the battery status slot, not an RSSI - every genuine legacy RSSI in this corpus sits in the second field and is negative. Publishing it as dBm produced a phantom '0 dBm' sensor.

Live frame from a maintainer-owned gauge. Two bugs at once: STA_RSSI carries a literal 0 (a real reading looks like 'E1 AF 00' -> -81), which surfaced as a phantom '0 dBm' the app does not show; and STA_7DAY_RAIN was present but the TLV path had no decoder for it, so 'Rain Last 7 Days' never appeared even though the app shows it.
